premise.claim: Docs/tooling PR (carve-out). Its load-bearing empirical claims about main were verified instead: CRD defaults apply on read without a write (VC-1), a controller restart changes nothing (VC-2), role label removal propagates with a single rbg/Apply field manager (VC-4), and a no-op v1alpha1 round trip rewrites the stored v1alpha2 object including resetting baseDelaySeconds 10 -> 30 (VC-5).
premise.evidence: results/integration-apiserver.txt (VC-1 A1-A4, VC-2 302-record no-op restart, VC-4 single-manager), results/vc5-envtest.txt (3/3 canaries), results/citation-check.txt (39/39)

findings.note: F5 is the wait-flake robustness gap; the contract maps to VC-1 passing (the harness retries once after the documented flake). Deterministic reproduction: results/f5-wait-flake.txt (2/3 failures right after CRD churn).
